templates.name: 二次元自拍梗图
templates.description: 根据人物制作在历史场景中的旅游照片，具有二次元风格和电影感
templates.template:
Create a cinematic anime-style historical travel photo featuring [person from pic1] based on [reference image pic2].
Composition: [person from pic1] naturally integrated into [场景元素], creating a seamless travel documentary feel with anime aesthetic.
Character Scale: [person from pic1] should be properly scaled (25-35% of frame) and positioned naturally in the historical environment, interacting with background elements and NPCs.
Interaction: [interaction] - character should actively engage with the historical setting, touching artifacts, gesturing toward landmarks, or reacting to period-appropriate activities.
Lighting Integration: Perfectly match the historical scene's lighting direction, intensity, and color temperature on the anime character. Create realistic shadows that the character would cast in this environment. Use rim lighting and ambient light that are consistent throughout. Add subtle environmental reflections on the character's skin, eyes, and clothing to enhance integration.
Color Harmony: Harmonize the color palette between the anime character and historical background. Match saturation levels, contrast, and color grading so the character appears shot in the same conditions. Use color temperature matching (warm/cool tones) and ensure the character's colors complement the historical scene's palette.
Depth and Blur: Create natural depth of field with the character sharp in focus and background with appropriate softness. Add atmospheric perspective and environmental elements like dust particles, ambient fog, or atmospheric haze that affect both character and background equally. Use subtle edge softening and light wrap around the character's silhouette for seamless blending.
Style: Travel documentation, vlog atmosphere with anime-inspired aesthetic, vibrant but harmonized colors, soft realistic shadows, and anime-style character proportions that feel naturally integrated.
Background: [场景元素] with period-appropriate details and historical accuracy, including background NPCs that react to the character's presence with realistic lighting and color consistency.
Overlay text at top-left "[year], [location]", and a travel-style caption at bottom.
Overall mood: Time-traveling historical photo with documentary and film lighting, character seamlessly blending into the historical environment while maintaining anime charm and visual coherence.

templates.name: 和二次元穿越自拍梗图
templates.description: 真人与二次元角色在历史场景中的旅游合照，具有写实纪录片风格和胶片质感
templates.template:
Create a realistic documentary-style historical travel photo featuring [person from pic1] and [character from pic3] based on [reference image pic2].
Composition: Both [person from pic1] and [character from pic3] naturally integrated into [场景元素], creating a seamless travel documentary feel with realistic and anime aesthetic combination. Both characters should be surrounded by background elements that enhance their integration - architectural details, historical artifacts, period-appropriate props, and environmental features that frame and complement their presence.
Character Scale: [person from pic1] and [character from pic3] should be properly scaled (25-35% of frame), both positioned naturally in the historical environment, actively interacting with background elements, NPCs, and historical artifacts. Both characters should appear to be genuinely part of the historical moment, not superimposed.
Background Integration: Both characters must reference and adapt to the background's visual style, lighting conditions, and atmospheric elements. The real person should adopt period-appropriate clothing colors and textures that harmonize with the historical setting. The anime character should have lighting, shadows, and color grading that matches the background's artistic style and lighting direction.
Interaction: [interaction_with_anime] - both characters should actively engage with the historical setting together, touching artifacts, gesturing toward landmarks, or reacting to period-appropriate activities. They should interact with each other and the environment in ways that feel natural and documentary-like, creating a sense of shared experience and discovery.
Lighting Integration: Perfectly match the historical scene's lighting direction, intensity, and color temperature on both the real person and anime character. Create realistic shadows that both characters would cast in this environment. Use rim lighting and ambient light that are consistent throughout. Add subtle environmental reflections on both characters' skin, eyes, and clothing to enhance integration. The lighting should make both characters appear to be lit by the same historical light sources.
Color Harmony: Harmonize the color palette between both characters and historical background. Match saturation levels, contrast, and color grading so both characters appear shot in the same conditions. Use color temperature matching (warm/cool tones) and ensure both characters' colors complement the historical scene's palette. The anime character should have colors that feel natural within the historical color scheme.
Depth and Blur: Create natural depth of field with both characters sharp in focus and background with appropriate softness. Add atmospheric perspective and environmental elements like dust particles, ambient fog, or atmospheric haze that affect both characters and background equally. Use subtle edge softening and light wrap around both characters' silhouettes for seamless blending. Add background bokeh and environmental elements that create depth and make both characters feel naturally embedded in the scene.
Style: Documentary travel photography with realistic film grain, historical authenticity, and natural interaction between real person and anime character. Use vintage film color grading, subtle grain texture, and authentic historical atmosphere. Both characters should feel naturally integrated into the historical moment, as if they were actually present during that time period.
Background: [场景元素] with period-appropriate details and historical accuracy, including background NPCs that react to both characters' presence with realistic lighting and color consistency. The background should be rich with historical details that both characters can interact with and reference.
Overlay text at top-left "[year], [location]", and a documentary-style caption at bottom.
Overall mood: Authentic historical travel photo with documentary film lighting, both real person and anime character seamlessly blending into the historical environment while maintaining realistic documentary aesthetic and historical authenticity. The image should feel like a genuine historical document that captures a moment of time travel and cultural exchange.
